title: Cold read and fix terminology drift
description:
## Objective
Read the finished deck end to end and make five independently written files use one vocabulary.

## Spec Reference
`.devmeta/projects/2026-08-13-deck-coherence/2026-08-13-deck-coherence-spec.md` — Sections 1-3

## Scope
**Files:** any of `slides/pages/*.md`, and `slides/slides.md` if the title slide needs to match

## Implementation
1. Read slides.md and all five page files in order before editing anything.
2. Enforce: increment, iteration, feature, task, I&A cycle, tick. No sprint/story/phase/stage in prose.
3. 'epic' appears only on slide 7. Commands always in full backticked form.
4. Remove points repeated between the commands and example sections.
5. Check the seams: slide 3 promises two commands, slide 9 delivers them.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run build` then `cd slides && npm run slides`
Do NOT close until both pass and the count is 19.
acceptance_criteria: cd slides && npm run build exits 0; cd slides && npm run slides reports 19
